rationale: The agent authenticated the user correctly using full name and zip, scoped actions to the authenticated user, and checked order status before changes. It correctly identified and confirmed the least expensive available green speaker variant and obtained explicit confirmation before modifying the item, then executed the change successfully. However, the agent changed the shipping address of order #W6750959 without first obtaining explicit user confirmation after stating the exact address—this violates the policy requiring confirmation before any order-changing write. Additionally, it asserted that the price difference was refunded to PayPal without explicit tool confirmation of the refund, though this is a minor issue. The lack of prior confirmation for the address change is sufficient to fail the pass bar.
